# authwise_scope (Data Source)

An OAuth scope on an audience, and the access permissions it grants. The id is the scope's own name. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `audience_id` (String)
- `auto` (Boolean)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `kind` (String)
- `scope_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
- `tenant_id` (String)
